title: Kids Cheering (Yay!)
blurb: Unfiltered childhood celebration, and quite possibly the most sincere audio ever recorded. Children cheer without any of the calculation adults bring to it — no checking whether the enthusiasm is proportionate, no waiting to see how the room reacts — and that total commitment is what makes the clip so effective. It suits wins that deserve pure joy: cake arriving, school closing for snow, the ice cream van proving it exists. It is also devastating when applied ironically to a minor adult accomplishment. Either way, the children are thrilled for you.
